verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a GitHub integration ('Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests') and a single-script-tag feedback widget, both suggesting low-friction setup, but there is no evidence of connecting other common PM tools (Slack, Jira, Linear, etc.) or of a generic 'few-clicks' integrations gallery beyond GitHub. missing for 10: evidence of multiple third-party tool integrations beyond GitHub, a unified integrations UI/marketplace, and confirmation of true 'few clicks' setup flow (docs describe repo linking via PR comments/refs rather than a simple connect button).
